rapport_notes: Excellent repeat-customer rapport — referenced last year's move details from memory/system, genuine warmth, customer said he had 'a great time' with the company before.

evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: "if you're able to take a hard load or two the boxes that would help you save time and of course money by the end of the day. Does that sound fair?" — clean ask, then the customer responded before she moved on.

top_strength: Textbook close: "should we go in and lock the date for you, do you want us to help you with this move?" — near-verbatim match to the rubric's close script, and the customer booked immediately.
coaching_note: No agenda question and no damage-coverage/Meet-Your-Mover content — with a repeat customer this trusting, there was room to also plant the differentiators for referral value, not just get the booking.
